monthly_history_notes.creators_new_videos_new_lives_new: Count of NEWLY ADDED unique creators/videos/lives to FastMoss's all-time counter during that calendar month. This is NOT the same metric as trend28d.creators/videos/lives (which counts creators/videos/lives ACTIVE in a rolling 28-day window, including ones that existed before). Do not present these as equivalent in the UI — label clearly as 'ครีเอเตอร์/วิดีโอ/ไลฟ์ใหม่ที่เพิ่มในเดือนนี้' vs the 28-day snapshot's 'ที่ทำยอดใน 28 วัน'.
monthly_history_notes.products_sold: No daily/monthly breakdown exists for this metric in FastMoss's export — only the single latest 28-day trend value is available. Omitted from monthly_history entirely; UI should keep showing the trend28d value with a caveat rather than fabricate a monthly number.
monthly_history_notes.source: Derived from 180-day 'แนวโน้มข้อมูล' Data Trends daily export table (per shop), scraped 2026-08-27 covering 2026-02-28 to 2026-08-26.
